AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Environment name

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 3

  ApplicationSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application subnet 1

  ApplicationSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application subnet 2

  ApplicationSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.13.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application subnet 3

  DatabaseSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.21.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for database subnet 1

  DatabaseSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.22.0/24

    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.23.0/24

  RegionMap:
    us-east-1:
      AZs:
        - us-east-1a
        - us-east-1b
        - us-east-1c
    us-west-2:
      AZs:
        - us-west-2a
        - us-west-2b
        - us-west-2c
    eu-west-1:
      AZs:
        - eu-west-1a
        - eu-west-1b
        - eu-west-1c

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr

      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Public-Subnet-AZ3"

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Application-Subnet-AZ1"

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref 'AWS::Region', AZs]]
      CidrBlock: !Ref ApplicationSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Application-Subnet-AZ2"

  ApplicationSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !FindInMap [RegionMap, !Ref 'AWS::Region', AZs]]
      CidrBlock: !Ref ApplicationSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Application-Subnet-AZ3"

  DatabaseSubnet1:

    Properties:

      CidrBlock: !Ref DatabaseSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Database-Subnet-AZ2"

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      CidrBlock: !Ref DatabaseSubnet3Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Database-Subnet-AZ3"

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-AZ1"

  NatEIP2:

    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-AZ2"

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP

      Tags:

    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-Gateway-AZ1"

  NatGateway2:

      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
